replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
After talking to the seniors we have decided to deny this appeal. Please send in another appeal in 6-8 months. The main reasons for denying this appeal are as follows;

- In both videos, with hand cams, the bridging is way too clean and doesn't make any sense. We got some people to try and recreate it and we could not, even with an autoclicker. Your bridging in a straight line with 14 cps, in a clean straight line. We came to the conclusion that it is impossible to do that without the aid of something, through testing. We got a valid opinion on that from an external source and he agreed. The video makes no sense whatsoever, you can't cleanly breezily with 14 cps in a straight line, it's simply impossible without something to help you do it.
- Again in both videos, there are instances where you lift your mouse to reposition it on the pad and you aren't clicking the mouse but the game is registering clicks, making us believe you're using something. It's quite clear you stop clicking at these points due to the fact the vibration, clicking noise and the fact that your fingers stop clicking.
